name: Clubhouse Media Group Inc.
summary: Clubhouse Media Group, Inc. (CMGR) specializes in empowering digital creators through the operation of dedicated content houses worldwide. The company provides a full suite of services, encompassing talent representation, content production, and strategic deal-making for influencers. Beyond its internal operations, CMGR offers a comprehensive array of support functions, including social media marketing, in-house studio facilities for content creation, technology development, and brand incubation. The company further leverages predictive analytics to optimize brand partnerships and facilitate paid promotional campaigns. Additionally, Clubhouse Media Group extends its talent management expertise and opportunities for brand collaborations to independent influencers. Founded in 2006, the company underwent a name change from Tongji Healthcare Group, Inc. to its current designation in January 2021. Clubhouse Media Group, Inc. maintains its headquarters in Las Vegas, Nevada.
